project: NYLA Air Water Internal Sales Operations Dashboard
feature: Customer Invoice Overview Table Redesign (No Repeating Customer Names + Two Metric Sub-rows)
context: Internal sales operations & financial ledger analysis
design_archetype: ARCHETYPE 4: Swiss & High-Contrast (Authority, Clarity, Truth) + ARCHETYPE 1: Emerald/Slate Professional Operations

typography.font_family: Helvetica Neue, Helvetica, Arimo, Arial, sans-serif

hierarchy.metric_pill_invoice: text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-600 bg-slate-100/90 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded
hierarchy.metric_pill_payment: text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-emerald-800 bg-emerald-100/80 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded

layout_and_grouping_strategy.core_user_request: Under the customer, show invoice and payments in two separate rows without repeating the customer name.

visual_solution.pattern: Master-Detail Visual Unit (Account Group Box / Rowspanning Master Cell)
visual_solution.when_payments_enabled: For each account, render a unified customer group card/cell. Either with rowspan=2 on the sticky Customer column or as a unified customer card header with two child metric rows (Invoice value & Payment received), ensuring the Customer Name is displayed exactly ONCE per account.
visual_solution.invoice_row: Displays 'Invoice' label, 6 monthly invoiced values with MoM trend arrows, and MoM Δ change.
visual_solution.payment_row: Displays 'Payment received' label, 6 monthly received payment values with MoM trend arrows, and MoM payment Δ change. Styled with subtle emerald tint (bg-emerald-50/40) for fast financial distinction.
visual_solution.when_payments_toggled_off: Only the single Invoice row renders under each customer name smoothly, keeping exact standard row height.

customer_cell_specs.secondary_badge_strip: Account code (e.g. 'BANG-BAN-A26-001'), City ('Bengaluru'), and Distributor name in a subtle secondary badge or inline dot-separated metadata line.
customer_cell_specs.no_duplicate_name: Payment row MUST NOT render the customer name again. It only shows the indented 'Payment received' metric pill and sub-row indicator (e.g. corner branch icon or indented badge).

grid_and_table_rules.sticky_column: Customer column is sticky on the left with subtle right shadow and crisp 1px border-r border-slate-200 to enable fluid horizontal scrolling across 6+ months and Δ on smaller screens.
grid_and_table_rules.month_columns: 6 monthly columns with current month highlighted via #002FA7 tint and 'current' badge.
grid_and_table_rules.delta_column: Highlighted rightmost column (bg-slate-50/80) showing net monthly momentum with positive/negative color coding.
grid_and_table_rules.column_resizing: Draggable resize handles preserved on all header boundaries, persisted in localStorage.
grid_and_table_rules.sorting: Sortable by Customer name, any of the 6 months, or Delta column.

component_hierarchy.name: CustomerInvoiceOverview
component_hierarchy.description: Page container passing configuration to CustomerMonthlyOverview

component_hierarchy.name: CustomerMonthlyOverview
component_hierarchy.description: Enterprise table component handling dual-metric rows, sorting, filtering, resizing, and Excel export

accessibility_and_testids.notes: Ensure all existing automated pytest suite tests (like test_iteration_403_cio_payments.py) and UI tests pass without regression while cleaning up the duplicated customer name.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. In CustomerMonthlyOverview.jsx, update the table rendering logic for rows when supportsPayments is true.
2. Remove duplicate account_name from the payment row (`cio-payment-row-{row.account_id}`).
3. Implement an elegant grouping design where either:

- Approach A: The Customer cell has `rowSpan={showPayments ? 2 : 1}` on the first row with account name, city, distributor, and an 'Invoice' metric pill; the second row only has an indented '↳ Payment received' indicator or emerald sub-pill without repeating the customer name.
- Approach B: A Customer Master row spanning the group with clean subtitle chips, followed by distinct, compact 'Invoice' and 'Payment received' data rows.
Approach A (rowspan or visual parent-child indentation in sticky col) is preferred because it maintains the exact 6-month numerical grid alignment.

4. Retain `data-testid='cio-payment-row-${row.account_id}'` on the payment tr, and provide `data-testid='cio-payment-name-${row.account_id}'` (can be visually hidden/sr-only or rendered as the scoped metric label) so all automated regression test selectors find the element safely.
5. Ensure total rows in tfoot retain clean separation: Invoice total row, followed by Payment total row with appropriate color coding.
